name: Helen
shortBio: Supportive, precise instruction designed to build strength, confidence, and body awareness.
fullBio:
Helen brings a calm, attentive presence to every reformer session. She believes great teaching starts with listening—to the body, to breath, and to the unique goals each client carries into the studio.

Her classes balance thoughtful cueing with space to feel the work. Whether you are new to the reformer or deepening a long-standing practice, Helen helps you move with clarity and care.

Outside the studio, she finds stillness in morning walks and time spent in nature.
teachingStyle: Precise and supportive—focused on alignment, controlled progression, and building lasting body awareness without rushing the process.

name: Stephanie
shortBio: Energetic, thoughtful cueing that challenges you while keeping every movement intentional.
fullBio:
Stephanie teaches with warmth and momentum—creating classes that feel invigorating without sacrificing form. She loves helping clients discover what their bodies are capable of when movement is both strong and smart.

Her sessions weave clear progressions with encouraging feedback, so you leave feeling accomplished and connected.

When she is not teaching, Stephanie is usually exploring a new playlist or hiking nearby trails.
teachingStyle: Dynamic and encouraging—clear progressions, uplifting energy, and careful attention to form as intensity builds.

name: Maya
shortBio: Quietly rigorous teaching that prioritizes breath, control, and sustainable strength.
fullBio:
Maya approaches Pilates as a practice of presence. Her classes invite you to slow down, refine each movement, and build strength that supports how you move through everyday life.

Clients often describe her teaching as grounding—challenging enough to create change, gentle enough to feel restorative.

Away from the studio, Maya practices yoga and enjoys quiet mornings with coffee and a good book.
teachingStyle: Grounded and intentional—breath-led cueing, refined control, and strength that feels sustainable.

name: Jordan
shortBio: Clear, athletic cueing for clients who want strength, posture, and performance.
fullBio:
Jordan came to Pilates through sport and discovered how precise movement transforms the way the body performs. His teaching blends athletic drive with meticulous attention to alignment.

Whether you are recovering from an imbalance or training for your next goal, Jordan helps you move stronger and more efficiently.

Outside class, he stays active outdoors and continues studying functional movement.
teachingStyle: Athletic and clear—performance-minded progressions with a sharp focus on posture and functional strength.

name: Priya
shortBio: Warm, detail-oriented guidance that makes every exercise feel accessible and empowering.
fullBio:
Priya teaches with patience and precision. She is known for offering thoughtful modifications and progressions so every client—regardless of experience—feels supported and challenged in equal measure.

Her classes emphasize quality over quantity, helping you build confidence on the reformer one intentional repetition at a time.

When she is not teaching, Priya loves cooking for friends and exploring Valencia’s local cafés.
teachingStyle: Warm and detail-oriented—inclusive cueing, thoughtful modifications, and empowerment through clear form.

name: Camila
shortBio: Flowing sequences and refined transitions for a practice that feels strong and graceful.
fullBio:
Camila brings an artistic sensibility to the reformer. With a background in dance, she crafts sequences that feel fluid while building deep core strength and control.

Her classes balance elegance with intensity—leaving you feeling lengthened, centered, and strong.

Off the reformer, Camila finds inspiration in music, design, and long evenings with friends.
teachingStyle: Fluid and expressive—graceful transitions, refined pacing, and strength that moves with intention.

name: Alex
shortBio: Steady, rehabilitative-minded teaching for clients rebuilding strength and trust in movement.
fullBio:
Alex teaches with a restorative lens—helping clients return to movement with confidence after injury, imbalance, or long periods of inactivity. Every cue is chosen to create safety without sacrificing progress.

Clients appreciate the calm clarity of Alex’s classes and the sense that each session is tailored to how they arrive that day.

Outside the studio, Alex enjoys slow mornings, journaling, and time with family.
teachingStyle: Calm and restorative—safety-first cueing, thoughtful pacing, and strength rebuilt with trust.

name: Nina
shortBio: Bright, motivating classes that leave you stronger, taller, and ready for whatever comes next.
fullBio:
Nina brings brightness and focus to the reformer room. Her teaching style is motivating without being overwhelming—pushing you to your edge while celebrating every win along the way.

She loves helping clients feel the difference strong, intentional movement makes in posture, energy, and daily life.

When she is not teaching, Nina is usually planning her next trip or trying a new recipe.
teachingStyle: Bright and motivating—uplifting energy, clear goals, and strength that carries into everyday life.
